SKIMMER / CONCEPTUAL SYSTEM VIEW
FPGA·DATAFLOW·SIGNALS

Skimmer

Exploring FPGA compute and dataflow, alongside the signal-processing chain of a ground receiver.

Look inside the system

The receiver sequence discussed in this project:

  • Yagi antenna and low-noise amplifier receive the signal.
  • The SDR provides digital I/Q samples.
  • Software compensates for Doppler shift before and during demodulation.
  • QPSK demodulation and error-correction decoding recover the information.

My interest: how compute, communication, and data movement fit into a complete system.

Control unit / About me

Interested in what
makes it all work.

I’m Arav Goswami, part of the Carnegie Mellon community. Computer architecture interests me because it connects the software we write to the machines that actually run it.

I also like getting hands-on—messing with sensors and motors, connecting things, and seeing what happens.
